acceptance_gates.proof: On a controlled test device, seed NON-PRODUCTION fixture values on v10.3.4; record only pass/fail/exists booleans. Never upload plaintext or hashes of secrets.
Verify legacy v10 encrypted data has migrated before v11. Old algorithms removed in v11. Stop if unresolved.

Use pinned v11.2.0 checkUpgradeStatus() BEFORE initializing CloudCredentialStore/Workshop/GitHub/Diagnostics; on disposable fixture data record only state/reason/entryCount/willDiscardOnNextAccess and platform receipt (no secrets). ok+none is only a candidate for independent review; legacyDataUnreadable, legacyDataDiscarded, unknown and ok+unsupportedPlatform stop; never auto-read when willDiscardOnNextAccess is true.

Inspect APK merged AndroidManifest.xml and effective dataExtractionRules/fullBackupContent for cloud/device transfer, then exercise backup/restore with synthetic secrets. Ensure encrypted preferences cannot be restored without associated Android Keystore material. Track Android issue #849; no production data or app configuration modifications in this intake.
After update to v11.2.0 in a disposable fixture installation, verify all four consumers can read matching fixture values and delete/update them; no auto-reset or silent loss.
Test credential lock/cancel/reboot/Keystore failure/namespace switch; errors must not erase previously valid secrets.
Demonstrate rollback/recovery for non-production fixtures and document migration or incompatibility. Never downgrade live encrypted stores experimentally.
Verify on a physical S24 FE with disposable fixtures; APK sign/update lineage preserved. No live tokens or personal credentials.
Independently test Windows, macOS and Linux target implementations when available; do not imply all platforms pass from one Android test.
Stable functional storage.secrets.v1 contract, Library-owned tested adapter, test report, licensed payload and independent security review before promotion.
